## About This Game

## 18,490 Bricks. One Small Town to Put Back Together.

A little town is waiting to be put back together. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks in a relaxing first-person tidy-up game, solo or in online co-op with up to 5 players. Turn scattered pieces into buildings, and watch your work bring the town to life.

## COLLECT, SORT, AND BUILD

Find the bricks you need by their shape and color. Follow each building’s plan and place the pieces in the right spots. Watch the piles get smaller as the walls grow taller.

## UNLOCK ABILITIES

Unlock helpful abilities to make the work easier. Use a magnet to collect bricks, a wheelbarrow to carry them, and scaffolding to reach higher places. Spend less time carrying and more time building.

## WATCH THE TOWN CHANGE

Turn piles of bricks into a cozy little town. Walk through the streets and enjoy the buildings you’ve finished. With every building you complete, there’s more to see.

**One brick at a time. Better together.**

    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })

        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')

function makeBeveledBoxGeometry(size=1, bevel=0.06) {
  const s = size/2, r = size*0.08;

  geo.center();

}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by “Brick by Brick: Tidy up a small town.”

## Requirements
- User requested an exact copy of the named game.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest one; use a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Assistant chose to recreate the core loop, art direction, HUD, and progression as a web game.
- Research identified the reference as a first-person brick-collecting and town-rebuilding game, Steam app `5228920`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the fresh workspace and researched the reference game and its screenshots.
- Created a web-game scaffold, styling, shared game data, procedural audio, 3D graphics helpers, environment, and building systems.

### Active
- Continue implementing the playable game, connect the created systems, then run and verify it in a browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current project files and finish the remaining game systems and entry point.
2. Run the project and resolve any build/runtime issues.
3. Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; verify the game is playable.
4. Summarize assumptions and verification results when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page and Three.js import map.
- `css/style.css`: Game presentation and responsive styling.
- `js/data.js`: Brick definitions, palettes, town/building data.
- `js/gfx.js`: Shared Three.js helpers, geometry, textures, and positioning.
- `js/environment.js`: Town environment and collision logic.
- `js/buildings.js`: Procedural building construction and placement state.
- `js/audio.js`: Procedural WebAudio sound engine.
- `js/decor.js`: Imported by `js/buildings.js` for building decoration.
- `vendor/three.module.min.js`: Locally vendored Three.js.
- `assets/`: Font assets referenced by the stylesheet.
- `/tmp/opencode/ref/`: Downloaded Steam reference screenshots and images.

- Reference URL researched: `https://store.steampowered.com/app/5228920/Brick_by_Brick_Tidy_Up_the_Small_Town/`.

221: export function shade(hex, amt) {
222:   const n = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
223:   let r = (n >> 16) & 255, g = (n >> 8) & 255, b = n & 255;
224:   if (amt >= 0) {
225:     r = Math.round(r + (255 - r) * amt);
226:     g = Math.round(g + (255 - g) * amt);
227:     b = Math.round(b + (255 - b) * amt);
228:   } else {
229:     const f = 1 + amt;
230:     r = Math.round(r * f); g = Math.round(g * f); b = Math.round(b * f);
231:   }
232:   return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
233: }
234: 
235: export function shadeHex(hex, amt) {
236:   const s = shade(hex, amt);
237:   const m = s.match(/\d+/g);
238:   return '#' + m.map(v => Number(v).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
239: }

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')

      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))

  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {

        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
